verdict.rationale: Orrick's own pages say it advises venture-backed companies through exit. The UK page covers "incubation through to exit", the France page names "cross border M&A and IPOs" for future unicorns and scaleups, the Germany page claims top-10 global M&A rankings with "increasingly startups", and the Technology Transactions page cites sell-side M&A for 3,000+ emerging tech clients. These are only passing mentions on regional or adjacent-practice pages, and IPO experience appears just once. missing for 10: a dedicated M&A or exit practice page for venture-backed companies, a dedicated IPO/capital-markets page with track record (deal counts, rankings, examples), and independent or community corroboration of exit work.
